verdict.rationale: OneDrive is a cloud file storage and sync service, not an agent or AI client that invokes tools. Plugging MCP servers into it as a tool-consuming client is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows OneDrive acting as an MCP client; the Graph API, Graph Explorer and sandbox items describe OneDrive's own API surface, not consumption of external tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
